name: core.openwop.connections.google-merchant
description: Google Merchant Center connection pack (RFC 0095) — OAuth2 provider for the Merchant API (products). Used by the Campaign Studio product-feed push (ADR 0952 D6): the commerce catalog is sent as product inputs to the org's Merchant Center account. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the OAuth client id/secret host-side (ADR 0024 §7). The push stays unverified until it runs against a test Merchant Center account.
